scope: Graph Engineering runtime with an Orca execution-host compatibility bridge
known_residuals: Orca Orchestration is experimental and its CLI JSON contract may change.
The --all plus --wait parallel message pattern requires a live pinned-version canary.
Agent Permissions Manual confirmation is operator self-attestation.
The explicit repo selector is configuration, not a cryptographic binding to the displayed Orca project.
The compatibility bridge requires a locally accessible absolute Orca worktree path.
Decision gates are projected as blocked results; full bidirectional gate reconciliation is not implemented.
Agent/verifier and human role identities are not cryptographically attested.
Git worktrees isolate files, not network or the operating-system kernel.
Vendor CLI/SDK interfaces require version-pinned live canaries.
claims_not_made: No real Orca Desktop runtime or authenticated vendor agent was executed in this build environment.
The bridge is not strict Orca-native state ownership.
Remote Orca Server and SSH worktrees are not supported by the local report transport.
No unattended workspace mutation, push, merge, PR, deployment, or production database action is approved.
Offline fake-Orca validation does not prove live Orca compatibility.
